name: Ragtliffe Verhoeven
original_name: ラグトリフ·フェルフーフェン
source:
The "janitor," who cleans up crime scenes and disposes of bodies for the CR:5.

Named "Ragtliffe" because his drunk father couldn't spell "Radcliffe."
